question: Which one of the following occurs when current expenses exceed the amount of income received through standard operations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Budget Deficit**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• A** budget deficit **happens when spending surpass receipts and might reflect a country's financial health.
 
• The word is usually used to **allude to government expenditure.**
 
• **Budget Deficit **= Total Expenditur
